title: PWM Generator (Five-phase, Two-level)
text: Generate five-phase, two-level pulse width modulated waveform, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Sampling mode} sets Wave-sampling method; {Continuous PWM} sets the continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal, {Switching frequency (Hz)} sets the switching rate 1e3 and {Sample time (s)} sets the block sample time 5e-5. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Continuous PWM
params.values: Continuous pulse width modulation method SPWM: sinusoidal PWM (default) | SVM: space vector modulation
